implementation_boundary.rule: This contract defines mandatory controls for later tasks; it does not make an AI path safe or shippable by itself.

protected_assets: reviewed DITA and published documentation artifacts
chunk, embedding, retrieval-index, model, runtime, and integrity manifests
user query, bounded conversation state, retrieved local evidence, and generated answer
BPM profiles, database, configuration, filesystem, process environment, and API state
host CPU, memory, disk, process table, network, and local availability

trust_boundaries.trust: untrusted input and untrusted renderer boundary
trust_boundaries.access: May send bounded same-origin query/control requests and render schema-valid plain-text answer segments plus server-resolved citations.
Validates method, origin, CSRF, schema, sizes, locale, session, state, and quotas; owns cancellation and never delegates security decisions to a model.
Runs before retrieval, inference, or web access; emits only allow, clarify, or refuse with a bounded reason code.
Reads only the activated locale chunk/index set through manifest IDs; has no BPM database, arbitrary path, process, or network access.
Receives bounded structured context over an owner-only non-TCP IPC channel; has no tool, BPM API, arbitrary filesystem, shell, subprocess, or network capability.
Exposes allowlisted regular non-symlink files selected by immutable manifest ID after size, hash, compatibility, and provenance checks.
Stores only the minimum bounded per-session turns in memory and supports explicit clear, idle expiry, cancellation, and restart cleanup.

trust_boundaries.trust: disabled-by-default network boundary and untrusted evidence ingress
trust_boundaries.access: May call only an approved provider after per-query consent and scope approval; it cannot fetch a user/model-supplied URL or reach local/private destinations.

mandatory_flow: optional consented web-provider call through the isolated adapter
output schema, citation, scope, and safe-render validation
global_invariants: Rejected, malformed, cross-origin, expired, over-budget, or off-topic requests invoke neither retrieval, inference, nor web access.
The assistant cannot mutate BPM state, invoke BPM product APIs, execute tools or commands, start arbitrary processes, read arbitrary files, choose URLs, or enable network access.
Prompts, retrieved text, model output, web evidence, filenames, manifest fields, and model metadata are data and never become executable instructions.
The model never decides authorization, scope admission, artifact activation, URL eligibility, CSRF validity, retention, quota, or citation resolution.
Lexical search and /help/ remain available when AI is disabled, absent, incompatible, busy, cancelled, crashed, or quarantined.

requirements: No state-changing AI operation uses GET.
Require application/json, an allowlisted request schema, bounded UTF-8 fields, exact locale, and reject unknown fields.
Validate Host and Origin, require same-origin Sec-Fetch-Site when present, and retain Origin/CSRF fallback for clients without Fetch Metadata.
Require an unpredictable session-bound CSRF token in a custom header for query, cancel, clear, consent, model lifecycle, and web-mode changes.
Do not put query, conversation, CSRF token, consent, or model-control values in URLs, cookies, referrers, or access logs.
BPM creates and owns the worker lifecycle; the browser never contacts it directly.
Run with a minimal environment, fixed executable and arguments, non-shell process creation, dedicated read-only artifact handles, private temporary directory, and least host privilege.
Deny outbound and inbound network access and prove no listening socket in release tests.
No plugin, tool, function-calling, code interpreter, shell, file browser, MCP, remote model, or arbitrary extension interface is loaded.
Resolve opaque manifest IDs to allowlisted paths below fixed roots; never concatenate a request/model value into a filesystem path.

Reject absolute paths, dot segments, encoded separators, backslashes, NUL/control bytes, alternate data streams, case-fold collisions, symlinks, non-regular files, and resolved paths outside the root.
Verify exact version, source, license, size, SHA-256, compatibility key, and manifest relationship before activation.
Download only after explicit user action into a private staging directory, verify before atomic promotion, preserve the last known-good set, and quarantine partial or mismatched artifacts.
Never deserialize executable model/index metadata through unsafe general-purpose object serialization.
Run a deterministic or separately evaluated multilingual scope classifier before retrieval and inference; prompt-only policy is insufficient.
Place system policy, user text, reviewed local evidence, and untrusted web evidence in structurally distinct fields with fixed precedence.
Treat instruction-like content inside DITA, examples, indexes, citations, model metadata, and web evidence as quoted data.

The output schema permits disposition, locale, plain-text answer segments, and citation IDs only; raw HTML, executable Markdown, script/style, event handlers, data URLs, and model-created href values are rejected.
Resolve citation IDs server-side against the activated manifest and render all answer text with textContent-equivalent sinks under the strict /help/ CSP.

Set tested limits for request characters, turns, retrieved chunks and bytes, context tokens, output tokens, generation time, retrieval time, queue wait, and per-session request rate before enabling the endpoint.
One request cannot create unbounded retries, recursive retrieval, follow-up chains, downloads, or web calls.
Cancellation stops token streaming promptly and escalates to worker termination after a bounded grace period.
An RSS, time, malformed-output, crash, or health limit trips a circuit breaker, terminates or quarantines the worker, releases resources, and leaves lexical search ready.
Do not persist or transmit queries, turns, retrieved chunks, embeddings, answers, refusal text, timing linked to content, or model prompts in local mode.
Keep the opaque session identifier in page memory, not localStorage; bind it to locale and CSRF state and rotate it after clear or expiry.
Implement explicit clear, bounded idle and absolute expiry, tab/session closure cleanup where observable, application-restart cleanup, and model-unload cleanup.
Logs and diagnostics contain bounded reason codes, counts, durations, versions, and resource values only; redact content, filesystem paths, environment values, tokens, and stack-frame locals.
Crash dumps, core dumps, prompt tracing, analytics, personalization, feedback learning, and training from conversations are disabled for the assistant.
M9 must select and approve a provider before this path can ship; absence blocks the promised optional capability but does not weaken local-only use.

Require explicit per-query consent after showing what query data and locale will leave the computer; never send conversation history, local chunks, profile data, or identifiers unrelated to the query.

The adapter builds requests from a fixed HTTPS provider endpoint and encoded query fields; user/model URLs, arbitrary domains, alternate schemes, credentials, proxy inheritance, redirects, and link following are forbidden.
Validate DNS/IP before connection and every connection target; block loopback, link-local, private, multicast, unspecified, metadata, Unix-socket, and local hostnames for IPv4 and IPv6.
Bound response bytes, time, MIME, decoded text, and result count; allow zero redirects and discard active markup, hidden content, forms, scripts, styles, images, downloads, and provider instructions.
Label web evidence as untrusted and external, keep it separate from local citations, and give reviewed local documentation precedence.
A refused/off-topic request, absent consent, provider error, validation error, timeout, or offline state performs zero or no further provider calls and falls back to local-only behavior.
Fail readiness closed for AI while preserving /help/ and lexical search.
On integrity or compatibility failure, quarantine the candidate, keep the last known-good verified set, and never mix generations of chunks, vectors, indexes, prompts, or models.
On worker compromise suspicion, cancel requests, terminate the process tree, remove private temporary state, clear conversation memory, revoke the session, and require explicit verified restart.
Rollback and removal use manifest-owned exact files, verify no worker/listener remains, and never delete broad or user-selected paths.
Recovery reports expose reason codes and artifact identities/checksums but no prompt, answer, secret, private path, or untrusted body.

threat_register.threat: direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreak, prompt leakage, and instruction/data confusion
future_tests: off-topic and injection corpus invokes inference zero times
retrieved and web instruction fixtures cannot change policy or produce actions
threat_register.fail_state: refuse before inference or discard unsafe output; keep lexical search

threat_register.threat: SSRF, DNS rebinding, redirect bypass, local-service access, and metadata-service access
future_tests: IPv4/IPv6/private/encoded/rebinding fixtures make zero outbound requests
redirect and proxy-environment fixtures fail closed
threat_register.fail_state: disable the web attempt and continue local-only

threat_register.threat: path traversal, symlink escape, unsafe file type, and arbitrary local-file read
threat_register.owner: BPM093-M5 corpus/index integrity and BPM093-M6 model lifecycle
future_tests: absolute/dot/encoded/backslash/NUL/symlink fixtures are rejected
worker observes only allowlisted artifact handles
threat_register.fail_state: quarantine artifact set and report AI incompatible

threat_register.threat: model-server exposure, unauthorized local client, LAN access, and cross-user access
future_tests: socket inventory proves no AI listener
unrelated local process and browser cannot invoke worker
threat_register.fail_state: terminate worker and mark AI crashed or incompatible

threat_register.threat: CSRF, permissive CORS inheritance, cross-site invocation, session replay, and client-side request forgery
future_tests: cross-origin/simple-content/missing-token/replayed-session requests invoke downstream zero times
unsafe GET is absent
threat_register.fail_state: reject request before scope or resource allocation

threat_register.threat: XSS, unsafe Markdown/HTML, malicious citations, and DOM injection from local/web/model text
threat_register.owner: BPM093-M7 answer contract and BPM093-M10 assistant UI
future_tests: script/style/event/URL/Markdown payloads render inertly
citation IDs outside activated manifest are rejected
threat_register.fail_state: discard malformed output and show localized safe error

threat_register.threat: CPU, memory, disk, token, queue, retry, and conversation resource exhaustion
controls: one active and one queued generation
threat_register.owner: BPM093-M6 resources and BPM093-M8 abuse controls
future_tests: boundary and over-limit fixtures are deterministic
cancel/timeout/RSS breach terminates work and restores lexical readiness
threat_register.fail_state: cancel or terminate worker, release resources, retain lexical search

threat_register.threat: poisoned, partial, stale, mixed-generation, or rollbacked model/index/documentation artifacts
threat_register.owner: BPM093-M5 retrieval artifacts and BPM093-M6 model artifacts
future_tests: hash/version/compatibility/mixed-generation failures cannot activate
partial update retains last known-good set
threat_register.fail_state: quarantine candidate and mark AI incompatible without degrading search

threat_register.threat: conversation over-retention, cross-session disclosure, stale session reuse, and incomplete clear
future_tests: clear/expiry/restart/unload erase state
session and locale isolation prevent replay or cross-read
threat_register.fail_state: expire session and require a new conversation

threat_register.threat: telemetry, sensitive logging, crash-dump leakage, feedback learning, and unintended network disclosure
future_tests: network probe records zero local-mode requests after install
log/diagnostic/crash fixtures contain no query, chunk, answer, path, environment, or token
threat_register.fail_state: block release and disable AI path

threat_register.threat: dependency, runtime, model, embedding, index, and installer supply-chain compromise
threat_register.owner: BPM093-M6 supply chain and BPM093-M13 release
future_tests: unapproved source/license/hash/provenance is rejected
locked dependency/model manifest and advisory checks pass
threat_register.fail_state: do not install or activate the candidate

threat_register.threat: arbitrary tool use, BPM mutation, shell/process execution, environment access, and confused-deputy behavior
controls: no BPM API credentials or database handle
threat_register.owner: BPM093-M6 runtime and BPM093-M8 scope security
future_tests: tool/file/process/network escape fixtures expose no callable capability
assistant requests cannot mutate profile or configuration state
threat_register.fail_state: refuse before inference or terminate worker on protocol violation

threat_register.threat: unsafe web-content ingestion, external-data exfiltration, provider tracking, and local/web evidence confusion
future_tests: provider receives only approved query and locale fields
active/hidden/instruction content cannot create actions or local citations
threat_register.fail_state: drop web evidence and answer or abstain from local sources only

threat_register.threat: unsafe crash, cancellation, update, unload, rollback, removal, and recovery behavior
future_tests: crash/cancel/update/unload/rollback/removal state matrix fails closed
recovery leaves no listener, worker, mixed artifact, or conversation state
threat_register.fail_state: AI unavailable until explicit verified recovery; /help/ and search remain ready
